claims.answer: Cyrus has no desktop, mobile or browser work client of its own: people delegate work and follow sessions inside Linear (web, desktop, mobile), GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Zulip or Plane; the cyrus-ai CLI runs the edge worker on the user's machine; a closed hosted dashboard (app.atcyrus.com) configures paid plans.

evidence.finding: Failed commit statuses and check runs route to the existing responsible Cyrus session with revision validation, durable deduplication and bounded automatic attempts; does not create issues.

evidence.title: Setup scripts

evidence.title: Cyrus changelog
evidence.finding: v0.2.78 (2026-11-12) adds GitHub CI failure routing; action-required GitHub App permission changes; package list for runners and transports.

evidence.title: Cyrus homepage and FAQ
evidence.finding: FAQ: processes Linear issues assigned to Cyrus, creates worktrees and runs Claude Code, posts replies as comments, verifies webhook signatures, OAuth, configurable tool permissions; states SOC 2 Type I (older wording) while a banner announces Type II.

evidence.title: EdgeWorker source
evidence.locator: webhook handling, session start/stop, persisted state (lines 238, 707, 3925, 5259)
evidence.finding: EdgeWorker receives transport events, creates worktrees and runner sessions, handles stop signals from prompted webhooks and persists repository state.

evidence.title: GitService source
evidence.finding: Creates per-issue git worktrees under workspaceBaseDir and a plain folder when no repository is configured; lists worktrees via git worktree list.

evidence.title: Runner concurrency cap
evidence.finding: Global FIFO counting semaphore with live-adjustable limit bounds simultaneous runner sessions (maxConcurrentSessions in config-schemas.ts line 573).

evidence.title: Runner selection
evidence.finding: Runner and model chosen from description tags [agent=claude|gemini|codex|cursor|opencode] and [model=...] or Linear labels; default runner config or auto-detect from credentials.

evidence.finding: Bridges the AskUserQuestion tool with Linear agent elicitation select signals and resumes on the prompted webhook.

evidence.title: User access control
evidence.finding: Allow and block lists of Linear users (and Slack IDs) with configurable block behavior.

evidence.title: Egress proxy
evidence.finding: Local egress proxy filtering domains for Bash-spawned traffic when sandbox.enabled is true.

evidence.title: cyrus-tools MCP server
evidence.locator: tools: linear_agent_give_feedback, linear_get_agent_session(s), linear_get_child_issues, linear_set_issue_relation, linear_upload_file, post_message_to_codex
evidence.finding: Cyrus injects an MCP tool surface letting agents read child issues, set issue relations, give feedback to other agent sessions and message a Codex session.

evidence.title: Error reporter factory
evidence.finding: Sentry error reporting is created only when CYRUS_TEAM_ID is set and CYRUS_SENTRY_DISABLED is not truthy; scrubbers remove sensitive data.

evidence.title: Runner packages
evidence.locator: packages directory: claude-runner, codex-runner, cursor-runner, gemini-runner, opencode-runner, simple-agent-runner
evidence.finding: Separate runner packages for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and OpenCode plus transports for Linear, GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Zulip and Plane.

evidence.title: CLI commands
evidence.locator: commands directory: Auth, CheckTokens, RefreshToken, SelfAddRepo, SelfAuth, Start
evidence.finding: CLI commands cyrus auth, check-tokens, refresh-token, self-auth-linear, self-add-repo and start.

evidence.title: Orchestrator label prompt in config schema, prompts and changelog
evidence.locator: labelPrompts.orchestrator (config-schemas.ts line 152); packages/edge-worker/prompts/orchestrator.md; CHANGELOG.md entries for 0.2.13 (orchestrator label routing hardcoded) and 0.2.71 (orchestrator sessions resumed when a delegated sub-issue completes)
evidence.finding: Orchestrator mode is shipped: an issue labelled orchestrator runs the orchestrator prompt, which creates sub-issues and delegates them to Cyrus; completion of a child session resumes the parent orchestrator session. The mode is declared in the config schema and the changelog, not in docs/CONFIG_FILE.md.

evidence.title: Repository setup hook platform handling
evidence.locator: setup hook candidates and isWindows branches (around lines 1276-1280, 1436, 1569)
evidence.finding: The worktree setup-hook runner looks for cyrus-<hook>.sh on unix and cyrus-<hook>.ps1 or .cmd on Windows and branches on process.platform === 'win32'. Install docs (docs/SELF_HOSTING.md) give macOS and Linux steps only.

evidence.title: Cyrus v0.2.85 error reporter and auth command
evidence.finding: A default Sentry DSN is compiled in; reporting is a no-op if CYRUS_SENTRY_DISABLED is truthy or CYRUS_TEAM_ID is unset. cyrus auth writes CYRUS_TEAM_ID into the env file.

evidence.title: Cyrus createErrorReporter at v0.2.85
evidence.finding: At v0.2.85 a Sentry DSN is compiled in; reporting is a no-op when CYRUS_SENTRY_DISABLED is truthy or CYRUS_TEAM_ID is unset, and otherwise sends error Issues and logs through scrubbers (scrubSentryEvent, scrubSentryLog). No consent prompt is shown.

evidence.title: Cyrus AuthCommand at v0.2.85
evidence.finding: cyrus auth <auth-key> authenticates a Cyrus Pro plan device and writes CYRUS_TEAM_ID (with CYRUS_API_KEY, CYRUS_DEVICE_ID and CYRUS_APP_URL) into the env file, which switches the compiled-in Sentry reporting on.

evidence.title: Cyrus End-to-End Self-Hosting Guide at v0.2.85
evidence.locator: intro (line 23); public URL options (lines 76-77); credentials (lines 93-101, 191); install (line 172)
evidence.finding: The free self-hosted setup uses the user's own Linear OAuth app, a public URL (Cloudflare Tunnel or ngrok), ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN in an env file and npm install -g cyrus-ai; it does not use cyrus auth, so CYRUS_TEAM_ID stays unset.

evidence.title: Cyrus MCP tools at v0.2.85
evidence.locator: registerTool calls: linear_upload_file, linear_agent_give_feedback, linear_set_issue_relation, linear_get_child_issues, linear_get_agent_sessions
evidence.finding: Cyrus injects MCP tools that upload files to Linear, give feedback to agent sessions, set issue relations and read child issues and agent sessions.
